# README Task Template

Use this file as the source template for the `## Task` section in [README.md](../../README.md).

## Task Section Template

```md
## Task

- [ ] `TASK-001` Short imperative summary of the task.
  Current risk: Describe the current risk in one sentence.

- [ ] `TASK-002` Short imperative summary of the task.
  Current risk: Describe the current risk in one sentence.

- [ ] `TASK-003` Short imperative summary of the task.
  Current risk: Describe the current risk in one sentence.
```

## Single Task Item Template

```md
- [ ] `TASK-XXX` Short imperative summary of the task.
  Current risk: Describe the current risk in one sentence.
```

## Rules

- Keep task IDs stable once published.
- Use present tense and imperative style for the task summary.
- Keep each `Current risk` line concise and specific.
- Mark complete tasks with `[x]`.
